Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Getting used to library committee work？
Well, I'm pulling my weight, more or less.
Yeah. You're surprisingly diligent. I was shocked.
"Surprisingly" is rude.
Hey, I've been wanting to ask. Why'd you join the library committee？
Hmm... What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Because you like books？
Pretty much. Plus... back then, I didn't want to go home. That kind of thing.
I see. But you're still doing it, right？
That's... because, now, you know？ ...Right？
"Right？" should be enough for you to get it... Want a kick？
Kobayakawa
Hey, about why people joined the library committee. I asked some others too.
...You're really stuck on this.
Pretty much. And there was this one total powerhouse.
A powerhouse？
He wants to read every book in the library before he graduates. That's why he joined.
All of them!? That's crazy...
Crazy is right. Even the Japanese and English dictionaries. Even Rinko's speechless.
Huh... Speaking of dictionaries, everyone looks up dirty words in them, right！
No, they don't...
Sorry... Well, it's a guy thing！
You mean a PERVY guy thing, right？
Really, I'm sorry...
Kobayakawa
You know the suggestion box in the library？
...Oh. There was one of those. What about it？
The upperclassman in charge of the library newsletter...
wants to print suggestions from it. Only, nobody's submitting any.
Well, I've never seen anyone use it.
So she told Rinko and the other first-years to write fake ones.
So, staged. She must be really short on material.
So anyway, that's why I was writing suggestions.
What'd you write？
"Please stock The Complete Guide to Cheating."
(What kind of book is that...)
Oh yeah. The fake suggestions you wrote made it into the library newsletter.
Kobayakawa
The upperclassman in charge got chewed out by the teacher, though.
They found out it was staged？
No, no. Over Rinko's suggestion.
Well, a school library's not going to stock a cheating guide...
I never thought she'd actually print something that ridiculous...
You're terrible...
Oh yeah, apparently your class is on suggestion duty next？
Better think of something？
Let's see... How about "Please build private reading booths"？ They'd double as nap rooms for the committee.
Why not just go home and sleep？
Yes, ma'am...
Kobayakawa
Oh yeah, the committee's holding a reading marathon.
A reading marathon？
You compete to see how many books you can read before the deadline.
What a weird mash-up of reading and track.
Competing on numbers, though... What matters is what's in them, right？
If they're doing it anyway, they should add the reading long jump, pole vault, and hammer throw.
As if！
You're acting like it's not your problem, but every member has to join.
Seriously？
Good excuse to start, right？ For you.
I read a lot, you know？ Like...
Manga doesn't count as reading.
Okay...
Kobayakawa
The reading marathon's started. Are you actually reading？
Yeah！ I'm reading. I'm only about 20 pages in, though...
So you're not reading. Rinko's barely making progress either... Only on book three.
I see... That's pretty far along.
I used to spend a lot of free time reading, but I can't really now, right？
Why？
Because I'm with you like this, duh？
I see... I know！ We could have reading dates. Swap books we recommend and stuff.
Pass. If I'm with you, what's the point of reading by myself？
Stop grinning！
(I'm not！)
Kobayakawa
About the library suggestion box...
Yeah？
Some idiot keeps pushing for manga magazines on the book request list.
Manga？ Isn't that fine？
No. Allow one thing like that and there's no end to it.
Manga's not so bad. Plenty of famous people picked their careers because of manga.
Ichitaro from the Jankees went pro after reading "Southpaw League," you know.
Rinko reads manga too, you know. Like "NENE！"
I just don't want noisy people in the library. It's supposed to be quiet and calm...
Anyway, Rinko won't compromise. She's firmly against it.
(Better leave her be...)
So in the end they're stocking manga after all.
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Lots of people had been asking for it, apparently.
What's decided is decided.
I guess.
So today I made a purchase list right away and showed it to the teacher.
Huh. And what did the teacher say？
Praised it. Said it was a nice, high-school-appropriate selection.
High-school-appropriate manga？
"The Lay Judge System: A Manga Guide," "Tokugawa Ieyasu: The Manga, All 26 Volumes," and so on.
And so, peace in the library was preserved.
(She always comes out ahead somehow...)
Kobayakawa
Picked a book yet？ For the book report.
What's that for again？
They said it at the last committee meeting. We're entering the book report contest.
Oh, right... Uh-oh. I need to find a book.
Then want Rinko to pick one for you？
Really？
I am your girlfriend, after all.
That'd be a big help.
I'll pick a reeeally thick one, so look forward to it！
(Maybe I'll pick one myself after all...)
Kobayakawa
Nobody from our school placed in the book report contest, huh.
Well, people from all over the country enter. It's tough.
Too bad, after you worked so hard.
Then again, you took way too long to read it, right？
That's because ▲小早川＊▲ picked one with so many pages...
But, but. It was fun like Rinko said, right？
Yeah. It was a genre I'd never read, so it felt fresh. It was fun！
Then next time I'll pick another one. One thick enough to be a weapon.
(That's alarming in more ways than one...)
Did you hear？ About the library ghost.
Kobayakawa
What's that？ Never heard of it. Not interested, but I'll hear you out, I guess.
After dark, a girl in uniform with braids supposedly cries in front of the very back bookshelf...
Huh...？
▲小早川＊▲ was tidying up around there the other day, right？
Wh-What are you, stupid!? Ghosts don't exist！
You don't believe in that stuff？
Obviously. From now on, dumb ghost stories are totally banned.
Don't you want to check if it's true？
Not at all. What are you, a kid？
About the library ghost...
Kobayakawa
I'm pretty sure I banned that topic？
Now, now. Turns out it was made up.
...Oh. Obviously. Because ghosts don't exist.
It came from a library committee member. A total fabrication.
I can't believe people fall for rumors like that.
Well, now you can go to the back of the library without worrying.
It's not like Rinko couldn't go because she was scared, you know？
I just didn't have any reason to go, so I didn't.
Right. No way ▲小早川＊▲ would believe a tall tale like that.
Obviously！
Kobayakawa
About that suggestion box...
Ah. What was in it this time？
Someone said libraries these days have CDs and DVDs, so ours should too.
Huh, libraries have stuff like that？
Comedy, rakugo, stage recordings, classical... I don't really get it, but yeah.
If it's stuff like that, I might use it too.
They should stock new Western releases, like God.Mt and the Killer Bambis.
Isn't that just what ▲小早川＊▲ likes...？
So what？ It's a perk of the job.
Oh！ And if they got all of Ultra Combiner Volvavin, I could borrow it for my brother.
That's never happening...
Kobayakawa
About putting CDs and DVDs in the library...
Ah. Whatever happened with that？
On hold... They said it'd need playback equipment in the library and cost money.
With that reason, it's basically a no.
Probably. When you think about it, books are pretty cheap. They should just get more books already.
I'm fine with how it is...
I know. I'll put a request in the suggestion box: "More books！"
Vague again. Does that library even have room for more, though？
Just toss the boring books. If that's not enough, they can seize the art prep room or something.
(Seize...？ Since when does the library committee have that kind of power？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, did you hear？ The library's getting more books！
Oh yeah？
A graduate is donating a huge pile of books！
Glad I went along with ▲小早川＊▲ on those requests...
Maybe our requests went through after all？
Maybe.
How many are we getting？ We'll need to clear some shelves...
And shelving them is...？
Our job, obviously！ Counting on my boyfriend to work hard！
(She looks happy, so I guess it's fine...)
Kobayakawa
We finally finished shelving the library books.
Nobody told me there'd be that many...
Well, it was two truckloads.
How much was that guy planning to donate？ Seriously...
Apparently he's a writer. The type who buys out whole bookstore shelves for research.
So it's leftover research he doesn't need anymore. Still, way too many.
Truth is stranger than fiction...
(A writer's research materials... Would high schoolers even enjoy those？)
Kobayakawa
Ugh... What do I do...
What's wrong？
It's Rinko's turn to write the library newsletter.
Oh yeah？ But you just do it like usual, right？
Well... Most of what goes in is set, so that's fine. But the book review...
You're not good at writing those？
If I introduce it badly and people think it's boring, I'd hate that...
Have you picked the book？
Yeah. Rinko's favorite book.
If it's a book you love, just relax and write it. I'm looking forward to it.
You don't have to read it！
(So it's ▲小早川＊▲'s favorite book...)
Your library newsletter the other day was really good.
Kobayakawa
You read it？ I told you not to.
Sorry, sorry. But the book you introduced was already checked out.
Oh... Really.
Still, finding out ▲小早川＊▲ likes that kind of book was a surprise.
What's that？ It's surprising Rinko reads romance novels？
That's not what I mean. Just, books like that seem more for girly girls...
Oh, I see. So you're saying Rinko's not girly？
...Are you girly？
That does it！
Ow！
Kobayakawa
About the suggestion box...
Again？ It's pretty popular now.
"Please tell me the class and name of the girl who always sits by the window on weekends," it says.
How should we know！
Right？ Ask her yourself.
Next he'll be asking what books she checks out.
Not that we'd tell him. He can figure out Window Seat Girl's name and taste on his own.
Window Seat Girl...
Oh yeah, what happened with Window Seat Girl？
Kobayakawa
What, you like gossip？
Not really, but I can't help being curious.
Apparently it went well. Last Sunday they rode the swan boat at the lake.
The swan-shaped boat for two？ Window Seat Girl became Swan Boat Girl...
And then he asked me to tell him if I knew any good date spots.
He asked ▲小早川＊▲？
He just happened to catch me in the library. I managed to answer, sort of.
Then so you're ready if he asks again, we'd better go on more dates.
...Well, fine. I'll go along with it.
Kobayakawa
The book lending rules changed recently, right？
Yeah, it used to be five books at a time, now it's ten.
Because there are more books now, I guess？
Maybe？ That'll be a pain to manage, though...
But from a book lover's point of view, it's great, right？
How so？
Binge borrowing！
What's "binge borrowing"...？
Oh, I know！ I'll binge-read "The Lord of the Collars"！
(How many volumes is that...？)
Kobayakawa
That's a heavy load today...
You sure borrowed a lot of books.
Well, once I knew I could borrow so many, I just...
You took them all at once, right？ You could borrow them one at a time...
It's a series！
If one ends at a good part, I won't be able to sleep wondering what happens！
Won't you sleep even less once you start the next one？
Now, now, stop complaining！
Hey. I want to get home and read, so can you walk a little faster？
(I'm the one carrying the books, though...)
Kobayakawa
Do you know the school record for most library books checked out in three years？
No idea. They keep a record like that？
Yeah, I found it recently. 1,680 books.
Let's see, 365 days a year... That's way more than one a day.
Amazing, right？ Wonder if Rinko could break the record starting now.
No, no, no way.
It could be you, you know？
That's even more impossible.
Hmm, isn't there some way...
(Didn't she say before it's not about the numbers？)
Kobayakawa
So sleepy...
Hey, hey, are you okay？ What happened？
I was reading all night, and before I knew it, it was morning.
Was it that good a book？
No, I just read whatever I could grab. To set the record.
Ah, the three-year one... But that's overdoing it.
Yeah. Reading like this isn't much fun. Maybe I'll stop.
Do that. Besides, if my girlfriend's like that next to me, I'll be bored.
...Yeah, okay, I'll stop. For you. My boyfriend gets lonely, after all.
